what: T-CELL IMMUNE SYSTEM — NOT oneshot. They LOOP. They HUNT.
axiom: Thymus trains. T-cells patrol in loops. Killer hunts. Helper signals. Regulatory allows hormesis. Memory remembers.

t_cells.helper-cd4: CD4+ — coordinates response, signals other cells
t_cells.treg-suppressor: Treg — suppresses overreaction, allows hormesis at low toxicity
t_cells.memory-archive: Memory T — remembers past threats for fast re-response

hormesis.axiom: Small doses of toxin strengthen the organism. NOT=0 means non-self EXISTS.
hormesis.below_threshold: Regulatory T allows controlled exposure — HORMESIS
hormesis.above_threshold: Attack permitted — too toxic for hormesis

patrol_loop.checks: All 7 alive ports scanned each cycle
patrol_loop.random_hormesis: 30% chance per cycle of injecting a random toxin

ci_trans_layer: The immune system IS the CI/trans layer. Thymus = training. T-cells = tests. Killer = reject. Helper = signal. Regulatory = allow controlled failures. Memory = cache.
